packs.name: salamander

packs.description: Orchestral library by Versilian Studios: string sections (violins, violas, cellos, contrabass; sustain, pizzicato, spiccato), brass (trumpet, French horn, trombone, tuba; sustain and staccato), woodwinds (flute, oboe, clarinet, bassoon, piccolo), harp and timpani, plus key-split ensembles. packs.name: vcsl
packs.title: Versilian Community Sample Library (selection)
packs.description: Selection from VCSL: mallets (marimba, vibraphone, xylophone, glockenspiel, tubular bells, kalimba), pipe organ, tenor saxophone, harmonica, world and orchestral percussion (bongos, congas, cajon, darbuka, frame drum, tambourine, shakers, cabasa, claves, cowbells, woodblock, agogo, guiro, triangle, sleigh bells, vibraslap, slapstick, claps, suspended cymbal, gong, mark tree, concert bass drum). The release's SFZ maps xylophone and glockenspiel an octave below sounding pitch; corrected here.

packs.name: tr808
packs.title: Roland TR-808 (Michael Fischer, 1994)
packs.description: 116 samples taken directly from a TR-808 (serial 103852) by Michael Fischer: every knob at five positions. Variants per drum: bd and sd 25 each (tone x decay / snappy), cymbal 25, toms and congas 5, open hat 5.
packs.attribution: Roland TR-808 samples by Michael Fischer (Technopolis, 1994), packaged by TidalCycles
packs.licence_note: LICENSE of tidalcycles/sounds-tr808-fischer: CC0 1.0 Universal; Fischer's original 1994 text (README): 'these samples are ABSOLUTELY FREE!'.

packs.name: tr909
packs.title: Roland TR-909 Ultimate Sample Pack (Audio Realism)
packs.description: 853 samples from an original TR-909 (44.1 kHz / 16-bit edition). Variant 0 of every drum has the 11 accent levels as velocity layers; further variants are the knob sweeps (bd: tune x attack x decay 125, sd: tune x tone x snappy 125, toms: tune x decay 121, hats: decay, cymbals: tune, clap and rim: individual shots). Flams, shuffle grooves and choke combinations are left out.
packs.licence: Audio Realism licence: free for personal and commercial use, no redistribution
packs.attribution: TR-909 Ultimate Sample Pack by Audio Realism (audiorealism.se)
packs.licence_note: audiorealism.se/TR-909-SamplePack: 'Free for personal & commercial use under the included license. Attribution appreciated.' Included Readme.txt: 'This sample pack may not be distributed in whole or in parts without permission.' claudius downloads the zip from audiorealism.se on each machine and never redistributes it.

packs.name: growlybass
packs.title: Growlybass (Karoryfer)
packs.description: Squier Jazz Bass recorded direct (both pickups, all knobs on 10), fingered sustained notes from low C# with 4 random round robins. Cut for size: 3 of the 4 velocity layers (pp, f, ff), no release, staccato or scrape samples. Downloaded as WAV, stored as lossless FLAC. The SFZ maps the bass at written pitch; it is shifted down an octave here so notes sound where they are asked.
packs.licence_note: LICENSE of sfzinstruments/karoryfer.growlybass: CC0 1.0 Universal (Karoryfer Samples' open-source instruments are released royalty-free for commercial and non-commercial use).

packs.name: voice
packs.title: Hadzi-Fia vowel (Karoryfer)
packs.description: Sustained 'a' vowel by a low male voice, sung chromatically C2 to A#3 (from Karoryfer's Hadzi-Fia library, published as the SFZ legato tutorial; its SFZ maps it an octave up, corrected here). 'choir' renders it as a 5-voice ensemble (detuned, staggered, spread): no clearly licensed multisampled choir could be found, so the choir is built from this solo voice, and notes above A#3 are pitched up from the top sample.
packs.attribution: Hadzi-Fia vowel samples by Karoryfer Samples (CC0)
